name: Konami VRC6a

components.role: VRC6 ASIC with direct register A0/A1 package wiring, PRG/CHR/nametable banking, RAM gate, IRQ and expansion audio
Reusable Konami VRC 8-bit reload/counter and 341-dot scanline prescaler circuitry
Chip-internal two-pulse plus sawtooth expansion-audio generator

connections: mapper.ChrBank0..7 + BankingMode -> ChrRom bank address inputs
notes: Mapper 24 identifies VRC6a register wiring. Expansion audio remains a cartridge-local physical output until a generic analog cartridge-connector path is modeled.
